tools.name: complete_video_upload
tools.description: Verify an uploaded recording and publish it.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List the recordings in this API key's project, including dashboard reviewer comments and viewed status. Expired recordings are omitted; each row's retainUntil is when that recording and its public link are deleted, and firstViewedAt is when someone first played the public link, or null if nobody has

tools.description: List the task names already used in this API key's project, so you can reuse an existing one instead of inventing a near-duplicate. tools.name: search_videos
tools.description: Find recordings in this API key's project by meaning as well as by wording — describe what the session was about, or name a task, and the closest recordings come back ranked. Use it before inventing a new TASK value, to find the recordings an earlier session already filed under one. Optional filters

tools.name: get_video_link
tools.description: Get a public link for a ready recording, with the retainUntil deadline after which the link stops working. Report the expiry alongside the link.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_videos · Private data: create_video_upload, list_videos, list_tasks, search_videos · Public sink: create_video_upload, complete_video_upload, list_videos, list_tasks · Destructive: delete_video.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_videos · Private data: create_video_upload, list_videos, list_tasks, search_videos · Public sink: create_video_upload, complete_video_upload, list_videos, list_tasks · Destructive: delete_video

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
